_meta.purpose: Regression detection thresholds. A REGRESSION entry is appended to GUARDIAN_ALERTS.md when ANY of these triggers fires for ANY URL vs. its prior baseline. Tighter values = more alerts; looser = quieter. v1 values come from SPEC §3 SC #6 + #11.

_notes.perf_score_drop_min: Drop of 5+ points day-over-day fires a REGRESSION. Lighthouse perf scores have ~3-pt CDN/cold-start variance; 5 catches real regressions without flap.
_notes.perf_score_floor: Even without a day-over-day drop, ANY page scoring below 80 fires a REGRESSION. Surfaces persistent perf debt.
_notes.a11y_score_drop_min: a11y is more deterministic than perf — 3 points is a real change.
_notes.axe_violation_increase_alert: Any new axe-core violation count > prior baseline fires a REGRESSION.
